name: Lamb Chops with Herb Butter
instructions: Mix softened butter with garlic, rosemary, and thyme. Roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate.
Bring lamb chops to room temperature 20 minutes before cooking.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat.
Sear chops 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Do not crowd the pan.
Rest 5 minutes. Top each chop with a slice of herb butter before serving.

substitutions.dairy_free: Skip herb butter or use dairy-free butter.
substitutions.low_carb: Already low-carb — serve with roasted asparagus.

notes: Lamb is best at medium-rare (135°F internal). Do not overcook or it becomes tough.
